synth.notes:
Two mirror axes (h-axis wall row, v-axis wall column); ACTION5 cycles h -> v -> piece0 -> piece1, and ACTION1-4 move the selected axis or piece by 3 cells within bounds.
Pieces are mirrored across the v-axis (visible gray reflection) and across the h-axis and both axes (invisible occluders whose holes show what's underneath, or 4 if nothing is). No reflection lands on a block a piece occupies.
Each frame is drawn layer by layer (wall < target < reflection < piece; holes are transparent; the selected object's holes are 0) and the objects are extracted again from the result.
Naming: 4-connected components ranked by (x,y). 1-pixel dots and invisible reflection components are dropped but still take a rank. A 0-dot takes a rank in the other of wall/player. Targets are clustered with Manhattan distance <= 6.
Not confirmed: the target clustering distance (fits only the T27/T32 splits), and draw order when visible and invisible reflections overlap. Passes 44/44 both stateless and with continui
